1 P.C. :
1) Petitioners, original accused Nos.1 and 2 have filed present Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of C.C. RVC 9 Wp-297-2024.doc No.370/PW/2012 pending on the file of Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, 32nd Court, Bandra Mumbai, arising out of F.I.R. No.336 of 2008 dated 8 th December 2008, registered with Nirmal Nagar Police Station, Mumbai under Sections 420 and 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, with the consent of Respondent No.2, the informant.

2) At the outset, learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that, the original accused No.3 Ramavtar Singhal Santoshi passed away on 24 th July 2014 and therefore the Petitioners are the only accused persons in the said crime.

2.1) He submitted that, the Petitioners and Respondent No.2 have now settled their disputes and differences amicably and the Petitioners have made the loss suffered by Respondent No.2 good, by paying the lump-sum compensation to her.
He therefore prayed that, the said crime may be quashed with the consent of Respondent No2.

3) Learned Advocate for Respondent No.2 tendered across the bar her Affidavit dated 5th July 2024,
duly affirmed before a Notary Public.
In the said Affidavit, Respondent No.2 has admitted the fact of amicable settlement and receipt of payment of Rs.3,50,000/- towards full and final settlement.
In para No.3 of her Affidavit, she has given her 'no objection' for quashing of the present case.

3.1) Respondent No.2 personally present in the Court and through her Advocate, reiterates the contents of her Affidavit dated 5 th July 2024 and RVC 9 Wp-297-2024.doc her no objection for quashing of the crime in question.

4) In view thereof, we are inclined to quash C.C. No.370/PW/2012 pending on the file of Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, 32 nd Court, Bandra Mumbai, arising out of F.I.R. No.336 of 2008 dated 8 th December 2008, registered with Nirmal Nagar Police Station, Mumbai.
